welcomeBody: A few quick choices so the intranet feels like yours. It takes about two minutes, and everything can be changed later in Settings.
welcomeItem_profile: Your profile — photo, name and role
welcomeItem_appearance: Light or dark, and your language
welcomeItem_workspace: Where you start and how your calendar looks
welcomeItem_notifications: What you hear about, and how
profileHint: This is how colleagues see you in the directory, in chat and on announcements.
appearanceHint: Pick what's easiest to read. System follows your device's light or dark setting.
workspaceHint: The page you land on after signing in, and how your calendar opens.
notificationsHint: Choose what reaches you. You can fine-tune single types later in Settings.
managerHint: The people you report to — they approve your absences and are a good first contact.
finishBody: Want a short tour of the main pages next? It points things out right where they are.
later_security: Secure your account with a passkey
later_ai: Set up how the AI assistant helps you
later_help: Where to go with a question or problem
restartOnboardingHint: Go through profile, appearance, workspace and notification choices again.
